name: workflow-guardrail-candidates
purpose: Binary calibration pack for recurring workflow guardrail recommendations.
binary_criteria: PASS iff the candidate is deterministic, bounded, and enforceable by one repo-native validator or fixture; otherwise FAIL.
calibration_policy: Treat held_out cases as calibration-only before using any score as proof.

cases.source_pattern: Repeated runtime drift in mise shim resolution or uv cache writes.
A stale feature flag or removed config key keeps reappearing in workflow evidence.
Readiness claims keep appearing without an exact command or workflow-closeout receipt.
A coordinator or subagent reports completion without the required artifact or manifest.
A new workflow P0 should block unrelated work until it is implemented, explicitly deferred, or downgraded by evidence.
A recurring Codex workflow anti-pattern is broad enough to deserve policy coverage but still needs a narrow machine-checkable surface.
